name: Crystal Cluster
label: Quest
description: Crystal Cluster: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: There are times which you may be entrenched in battle for days or weeks on end. During those longer periods of activity you may end up collecting large clusters of the Frostwolf's storm crystals.
The Circle accepts such offerings, friend.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done, friend. I will use the power of these charms to augment the magic that has already been gathered. When enough power has been amassed, I shall focus the collected energies and call upon the Forest Lord to aid our cause.
